packageRules.description: Hold TypeScript at 6.x. typescript-eslint peer-requires typescript '>=4.8.4 <6.1.0' (still true as of 8.70.0), so a TS 7 bump has no resolvable tree: Renovate cannot refresh package-lock.json and opens the PR with package.json alone, which fails `npm ci` on every CI leg. Remove this rule once typescript-eslint declares TS 7 support.
